cases.preliminaryAbstractFinding: Review of 66 mostly low-quality studies reported postoperative continence impairment after sphincter-cutting fistula operations, including an aggregate 12.7% incidence.
cases.importantLimit: The studied exposure is sphincter-dividing surgery, not anal fistula alone. No inference for an untreated fistula or individual postoperative symptoms.
cases.reviewerQuestion: Verify operation type, sphincter injury, symptom onset, baseline continence and fuller study limitations.

cases.preliminaryAbstractFinding: Systematic review of 20 surgical lumbar-disc/cauda-equina studies identified erectile dysfunction among frequent male sexual complaints; reported prevalence ranges are broad.
cases.importantLimit: Selected postsurgical populations and heterogeneity do not quantify causation for every cauda equina presentation.
cases.reviewerQuestion: Review baseline erectile function, nerve injury, chronology, CES diagnosis and study-specific follow-up.

cases.preliminaryAbstractFinding: Consensus describes hepatic fibrosis as a progression mechanism through which some chronic liver diseases develop cirrhosis.
cases.importantLimit: This is a mechanistic consensus rather than a cohort-specific causal risk estimate; chronic liver disease does not invariably progress.
cases.reviewerQuestion: Confirm underlying liver disease, documented fibrosis stage, duration and competing cirrhosis etiologies.

cases.preliminaryAbstractFinding: A 255-person radiologically confirmed adult chronic-pyelonephritis follow-up found generally favorable prognosis among those with preserved baseline creatinine.
cases.importantLimit: The source argues against blanket renal-decline attribution in a preserved-function cohort; risk varies with bilateral scarring, baseline function, proteinuria and hypertension.
cases.reviewerQuestion: Check longitudinal eGFR, documented kidney scarring, renal infection history and competing CKD etiologies.

cases.preliminaryAbstractFinding: Review of 14 observational studies reported a modest CRS–OSA association; a Mendelian-randomization analysis estimated a directional CRS-to-OSA risk signal.
cases.importantLimit: Population associations and MR assumptions do not diagnose or establish individual causation; the claim needs confounder and phenotype scrutiny.
cases.reviewerQuestion: Evaluate OSA sleep-study evidence, CRS phenotype, timing, obesity/allergy factors and MR instrument assumptions.

cases.preliminaryAbstractFinding: European endocrine-hypertension consensus describes hypertension as a frequent manifestation of confirmed Cushing syndrome and hypercortisolism.
cases.importantLimit: Expert consensus provides a disease mechanism, not individualized diagnostic or blood-pressure attribution.
cases.reviewerQuestion: Confirm cortisol excess, exogenous glucocorticoid exposure, blood-pressure chronology and other hypertension contributors.

cases.preliminaryAbstractFinding: Systematic review of randomized psychotropic-drug trials found erectile dysfunction associated with antidepressant exposure versus placebo; the reported pooled odds ratio was 2.28.
cases.importantLimit: The evidence is for medication exposure, not a direct causal effect of a depressive-disorder diagnosis; drug classes vary.
cases.reviewerQuestion: Document exact treatment, dose, onset, alternative erectile-dysfunction causes and exposure-specific effects.

cases.preliminaryAbstractFinding: The cited international guideline concerns evaluation and management of primary hyperparathyroidism, including evaluation of organ involvement.
cases.importantLimit: The PubMed abstract alone does not establish the renal-stone statements cited in the authored note; primary, secondary and tertiary disease must not be conflated.
cases.reviewerQuestion: Read full guideline renal criteria, confirm primary hyperparathyroidism subtype and establish nephrolithiasis with imaging/stone evaluation.

cases.preliminaryAbstractFinding: The 2025 multidisciplinary high-blood-pressure guideline is a broad clinical practice guideline with a systematic evidence-search process.
cases.importantLimit: Its PubMed abstract does not supply the kidney-disease-specific risk estimates or directionality claimed; PubMed lists linked errata.
cases.reviewerQuestion: Review full CKD recommendations, corrigenda, kidney function trajectory and possible reverse causation.

cases.preliminaryAbstractFinding: The 2025 high-blood-pressure guideline is a clinical practice guideline and supersedes earlier hypertension guidance.
cases.importantLimit: Its PubMed abstract does not present the claimed heart-failure prevention effect or quantified pathway; linked errata require review.
cases.reviewerQuestion: Examine full heart-failure prevention sections, corrections, HF phenotype, antecedent BP and competing causes.

cases.preliminaryAbstractFinding: A conceptual review describes hypertensive myocardial remodeling and interstitial fibrosis in progression from hypertensive heart disease to heart failure.
cases.importantLimit: This is not an individual prospective causal adjudication; other heart-failure etiologies and subtype differences remain.
cases.reviewerQuestion: Check echocardiography/MRI, documented remodeling, heart-failure phenotype and competing cardiac diagnoses.

cases.preliminaryAbstractFinding: Andrology guideline recognizes bone loss in men with confirmed testosterone deficiency and recommends bone-health assessment including DXA.
cases.importantLimit: The guideline does not establish osteoporosis in every man with hypogonadism; it also notes limited fracture-prevention evidence for testosterone therapy.
cases.reviewerQuestion: Confirm hormone-deficiency phenotype, DXA or fragility-fracture data, age and other bone-loss factors.

cases.preliminaryAbstractFinding: Systematic review/meta-analysis of 37 studies reported tricuspid-regurgitation deterioration after implanted cardiac devices; lead interference was a measured risk factor.
cases.importantLimit: The target label encompasses all valve disorders, but the reported endpoint is specifically tricuspid regurgitation associated with device leads; high study heterogeneity.
cases.reviewerQuestion: Confirm transvenous lead crossing the tricuspid valve, echocardiographic before/after results, and other causes of regurgitation.

cases.preliminaryAbstractFinding: Randomized phase III ovarian-cancer treatment trial compared paclitaxel/carboplatin schedules and recorded peripheral neuropathy as a treatment adverse effect.
cases.importantLimit: This supports a regimen-specific chemotherapy complication, not neuropathy caused directly by ovarian-cancer diagnosis.
cases.reviewerQuestion: Confirm chemotherapy agent and timing, neuropathy phenotype, pre-treatment symptoms and other neuropathy etiologies.

cases.preliminaryAbstractFinding: Systematic review plus cohort examined visual deficits and outcomes in nonfunctioning pituitary macroadenoma with optic-chiasm compression.
cases.importantLimit: The original study does not apply to every pituitary neoplasm; PubMed lists a linked correction.
cases.reviewerQuestion: Verify tumor anatomy, MRI chiasmal compression, objective visual fields, decompression history and corrected paper.

cases.preliminaryAbstractFinding: Cross-sectional study of 2,040 men presenting with sexual dysfunction reported impaired erectile function associated with SSRI exposure.
cases.importantLimit: The study does not isolate PTSD patients or demonstrate that PTSD itself aggravated ED; selection, treatment and baseline confounding matter.
cases.reviewerQuestion: Assess exact SSRI use and timing, PTSD treatment chronology, ED course and alternate vascular/endocrine causes.

cases.preliminaryAbstractFinding: The cited ESC/ERS pulmonary-hypertension guideline is a topic-relevant original source but PubMed supplies no abstract for claim verification.
cases.importantLimit: Cannot verify the authored right-ventricular failure discussion from PubMed abstract. Pulmonary hypertension subgroups differ, and generic congestive heart failure is broader; a correction is linked.
cases.reviewerQuestion: Review full corrected guideline, PH subtype/hemodynamics, right-heart failure evidence and alternative left-heart disease.

cases.preliminaryAbstractFinding: Meta-analysis of 73 studies found anxiety symptoms prevalent in OSA cohorts and described a probably bidirectional relationship.
cases.importantLimit: This source cannot by itself justify the authored generic DIRECT_CAUSATION label or an individual nexus probability conclusion.
cases.reviewerQuestion: Review prospective direction-specific evidence, diagnosis-versus-symptom distinctions, sleep-apnea treatment and confounders.

cases.preliminaryAbstractFinding: Review/meta-analysis of 18 cross-sectional studies reported more depressive symptoms with greater OSA severity, with substantial heterogeneity.
cases.importantLimit: Cross-sectional association does not establish clinical worsening of an independently diagnosed depressive disorder; authored AGGRAVATION requires a different evidentiary standard.
cases.reviewerQuestion: Seek longitudinal measures of diagnosed depression, baseline severity, OSA treatment effects and alternative causes.

cases.preliminaryAbstractFinding: Systematic review/meta-analysis linked testicular-cancer survivor chemotherapy or radiotherapy exposure with higher testosterone-deficiency risk versus orchiectomy-alone comparison.
cases.importantLimit: Risk differs by treatment; the evidence is not automatic attribution of hypogonadism to any testicular cancer.
cases.reviewerQuestion: Confirm tumor treatment, orchiectomy extent, serial testosterone/LH values and non-treatment causes.

cases.preliminaryAbstractFinding: Older clinical series of 180 urethral-stenosis patients reported upper-tract complications, including ureterohydronephrosis in a subset.
cases.importantLimit: Selection and observational design do not establish that each stricture produces hydronephrosis; degree and duration of obstruction matter.
cases.reviewerQuestion: Require obstructive imaging, temporal association, infection history, and alternative causes of upper-tract dilation.
